design: 本方案严格遵循用户原生Android打车视觉规范与原项目UI架构，使用薄荷青绿(#009B90)、深墨(#111827)、白(#FFFFFF)作为核心视觉语言。首页BookingScreen彻底重构为上部真实PassengerMap(weight 0.43f，真实MapLibre+OpenFreeMap底图)与下部圆角白色浮层面板(weight 0.57f)，消除了巨型表单白卡与冗余大标题，首屏立即可视目的地与CTA呼叫按钮；保留即刻出发/预约叫车/司机竞价3模式轻量切换、起终点交换、稍后补充目的地，原更多行程设置/代叫/途经点/常用路线折叠收纳。LoginScreen采用R.drawable.yijiexing_welcome_hero品牌插画与精致登录卡片，不假装微信快捷登录；ProfileScreen升级为薄荷青绿轻量身份卡与层次分明的服务分组；全套17个Composable函数签名与控制逻辑逐字对齐，保证Material 3与现有依赖100%无缝编译运行。

functions.Field:
@Composable
fun Field(
  value: String,
  onValue: (String) -> Unit,
  label: String,
  type: KeyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
  lines: Int = 1,
) {
  OutlinedTextField(
    value = value,
    onValueChange = onValue,
    label = { Text(label, fontSize = 14.sp) },
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
    colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
      focusedBorderColor = Teal,
      unfocusedBorderColor = Color(0xFFE2E4E9),
      focusedLabelColor = Teal,
      unfocusedLabelColor = Muted,
      focusedContainerColor = Color(0xFFFBFBFC),
      unfocusedContainerColor = Color(0xFFFBFBFC),
    ),
    singleLine = lines == 1,
    minLines = lines,
    keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = type),
  )
}
functions.PassengerVisualTheme:
@Composable
fun PassengerVisualTheme(content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
  val colorScheme = lightColorScheme(
    primary = Teal,
    onPrimary = Color.White,
    primaryContainer = Color(0xFFE0F4F2),
    onPrimaryContainer = Color(0xFF004D47),
    secondary = Ink,
    onSecondary = Color.White,
    secondaryContainer = Color(0xFFF1F3F5),
    onSecondaryContainer = Ink,
    background = Paper,
    onBackground = Ink,
    surface = Color.White,
    surfaceTint = Color.White,
    onSurface = Ink,
    surfaceVariant = Color(0xFFF1F3F5),
    onSurfaceVariant = Muted,
    outline = Color(0xFFE5E7EB),
  )
  MaterialTheme(
    colorScheme = colorScheme,
    typography = Typography(
      bodyLarge = TextStyle(fontSize = 16.sp, lineHeight = 24.sp),
      bodyMedium = TextStyle(fontSize = 16.sp, lineHeight = 23.sp),
      bodySmall = TextStyle(fontSize = 13.sp, lineHeight = 19.sp),
      titleLarge = TextStyle(fontSize = 24.sp, lineHeight = 30.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
      titleMedium = TextStyle(fontSize = 18.sp, lineHeight = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),
      labelLarge = TextStyle(fontSize = 16.sp, lineHeight = 22.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),
    ),
    content = content,
  )
}
